accessible-deck, asset-inspect, bot, calendar, compass, context-head-budget, craft, crowding-limit, declared-deps, dedup, diagram, docs, drive, entropy-dashboard, forms, github-auth, google-auth, handoff, inbox, install, levels, link-shortener, mail, notes-notion, pdf, permissions, prepare, publish, reflow, research, roundup, size, slides, video-text, vpn-cin, wazip, web-search

6 automatic features sit on no band at all — nothing in this repo declares when they fire: antigravity-hooks, brain-attention, caveman, opencode-plugin, rtk-compaction, statusline.

Every band is read from a registration this repo holds — a harness settings file, the pre-commit dispatcher's own stage order, or the install step that registers what must live outside the repo. Nothing here is inferred from where a file sits: that guess put the norms on on save when a norm is loaded with AGENTS.md at every moment there is. A feature appears on every band it fires at, so the counts sum to more than the registry — context-chain alone is three.

A point is a file that calls feature_law.is_enabled(), read from core/features.txt § wired — so a wrong edge here is a wrong registry row. Two points carry a third of the workspace: switching off mirror.sh takes fourteen skills with it and norms.py ten norms, which is deliberate — a group with one publisher is switchable at all, and the alternative was fourteen call sites. It is still the concentration to know about before the ablation runs, because those two rows can never be ablated apart.

Rows and columns both come from core/features.txt. An empty column is a site that enforces nothing — a finding about the workspace, not about the drawing. Column tooltips carry the firing moment, read from the registrations themselves by core/hooks/trigger/trigger_law.py; a site marked no moment is one nothing in this repo registers.

the routing chain, three levels deep

60 directories sit deeper than level 3 and are not drawn. They are reached by the same chain, one step at a time — which is the point of the routing tree rather than a gap in it.

Every edge is read from a generated routing block — the same table an agent follows. Nothing here is drawn by hand, so a wrong edge is a wrong routing table, and fixing the picture means fixing the source. Parsed 135 of 135 blocks.

tracked bytes per directory

987 tracked files, 3837 KB, folded to two levels. The inventory is git ls-files and never a directory walk — which is what keeps .venv, Downloads/ and the trash out of a picture of the workspace, three directories that would otherwise dwarf everything real.

coverage parsed 135 of 135 routing blocks · none unparsed

scope the workspace repository. 34 repositories nested inside it are drawn as directories and no deeper: each is its own repository, and none carries a picture of its own.

what is inferred nothing, as of 2026-08-18. Every edge above renders declared or generated data, the firing moment included: core/hooks/trigger/trigger_law.py reads it from the registrations, the pre-commit dispatcher's own stage order and the install steps. What the registrations cannot place is counted as a gap instead of guessed at.

how to change it edit the source, not this file: core/features.txt for the matrix, a directory's CONTEXT.md for the routing tree. Regenerated and committed by /roundup at every session close, so a stale picture is a bug in the close, not a fact of life.
